extension.summary: Standalone Stremio-style catalog/stream client for Kodi with TMDb Helper integration, Plex/Emby/Silo sources, Trakt PIN linking and scrobble.
عميل مستقل لكتالوجات وروابط Stremio داخل Kodi مع دعم مشغّل TMDb Helper ومصادر Plex وEmby وSilo وربط Trakt عبر PIN.
extension.description: Standalone Dex Hub for Kodi. Add compatible Stremio manifests, browse provider catalogs, use native Plex, Emby/Jellyfin and Silo sources, play streams with external subtitles, link Trakt, reuse Dex Hub as a TMDb Helper player, and keep a unified local continue-watching list.

Dex Hub نسخة مستقلة لـ Kodi. أضف روابط Stremio، واستخدم مصادر Plex وEmby/Jellyfin وSilo الأصلية، وشغّل الترجمات الخارجية، واربط Trakt، واستخدم Dex Hub كمشغّل لـ TMDb Helper، وحافظ على قائمة متابعة موحّدة محلياً.

extension.news: 5.10.547: No more frozen screen before playback with AIOStreams links that have no file extension (Dex Hub asked the link for its file type and waited, up to 27 s). It now takes the type from the file name or lets the player find it. The sources list opens faster: building and sorting the rows takes about half the time, and they are saved to the cache in one write instead of one per row. Search has its own workers instead of sharing them with the Home rows. A catalog that refuses searches (an error like 404) sits out for 30 minutes, one that never answers in time for 10 minutes, and it is back as soon as it answers. A repeated search uses the saved answers at once instead of waiting. Also in this build, from 5.10.546: The Full disc ISO filter and the ISO badge now show for AIOStreams results (their BR-DISK / ISO tag is in the description, which Dex Hub did not read). A disc link that takes long to start (usenet) is now waited for, up to 75 s, before Dex Hub decides it is not a disc. Also in this build, from 5.10.545: New settings page: Left and Right change a value right on its row, the line at the bottom says what the option does, and Back goes to the sections before closing. New Edit Home: only the rows you see are listed and the hidden ones fold into one line, Left and Right change a row's style, one Add rows button opens Dex Hub, DexWorld, YouTube or any add-on, and Back goes to the sections. The row menu had empty lines (Kodi's font has no emoji); fixed. Also in this build, from 5.10.544: No more error lines when TinyPPI, TMDb Helper or another add-on is installed but turned off (Dex Hub now treats it as missing). The English look no longer shows Arabic words in the Stremio sync menu, Silo menus and messages, folder covers and subtitle sync notes. The Show and hide rows button in Edit the Home screen had an empty label; fixed. Also in this build, from 5.10.543: Your NAS as a source (found on the network, guest folders open without a password). Full Blu-ray discs (ISO, BDMV) get a badge and a filter. Basic settings now have Sources and Rows sections; OK on a row opens one menu to hide, move or restyle it, and Show and hide rows ticks them all at once. Fixes Kodi 22 crashes that closed the app (Dex Hub and the Kodi add-ons it searches with no longer leave Python weak callbacks behind), and a second copy of the background service no longer starts. Kodi logs can be downloaded from the phone setup page. An IPTV get.php link added as M3U is added as Xtream (panels that refuse the playlist with error 884 still work). Continue Watching fills from Trakt again on a profile that had never pulled it.
